title: Colonal Kingdom SMP RP
description: Resource Pack for the Colonal Kingdom SMP
body:
The Colonal Kingdom SMP Resource Pack is a collection of textures assembled by Colonal. It is a combination of several  Resource Pack by Colonal meant specifically for use on the the Colonal Kingdom SMP, a subscriber server hosted by Colonal. 

Learn how to join the community in [discord](https://discord.gg/vSppQSVbKa)!
